## What this changes

Say what changes and why, in a sentence or two. For a feature, link its spec under `specs/`.

## Safety

Say what the change allows, what could go wrong, and how to undo it. Write "None" when nothing applies.

## Evidence

Show test output, a check report, or a contact sheet.

## Checklist

- [ ] The tests came first, and `uv run pytest` passes.
- [ ] `uv run pre-commit run --all-files` passes.
- [ ] The change commits no PDFs, videos, audio, transcripts, or course material.
- [ ] No test or CI step calls a language model.
